estimands.A: retrospective known-document-supervision-purged pipeline sensitivity; not legal-case-disjoint or historically available-label prediction
estimands.B: sensitivity to three fixed featurewise FIN87 donor completions; not missingness-neutral or historical missing-data recovery
estimands.B0: financial-block deletion sensitivity for the 25-column M5-to-M11 expansion; no direct FIN87 channel, not certification of other inputs
estimands.C: retrospective three-flag predictability diagnostic, not a deployable benchmark

case_blocking.scope: qualifying-positive row-to-ALL-usable-document-key incidence from pinned StageA/StageE/StageF lineage
case_blocking.training_drop: positive and any usable key in original validation-positive keys UNION original test-positive keys
case_blocking.validation_drop: positive and any usable key in original test-positive keys
case_blocking.negatives: unchanged; qualified-event mapping covers positives and does not establish negative legal-case membership
case_blocking.unknown_positive_keys: retain; report no-key and partially-keyed rows separately; unknown is not clean
case_blocking.original_label_files: never modify; explicit in-memory train_fit / validation_select masks
case_blocking.scaler_fit_population: retained eligible training rows after the family-A purge
case_blocking.graph_covariates_and_edges: retain original annual nodes, features, reverse edges and multiplicity, including blocked rows as non-supervised graph context
case_blocking.test_D_and_O_masks: frozen V26 masks, NOT recomputed after purge
case_blocking.multi_document_rows: retain all usable keys; exclude entire positive row if ANY key matches; never truncate to first event
case_blocking.unreconciled_key_collision_or_lineage_fa: STOP before any fit; no outcome-driven key repair

donor_completion.affected_columns: FIN87 only, exact ordered whitelist in columns.FIN87
donor_completion.affected_cells: nonfinite cells in eligible rows, prior to learner zero-fill; preserve ALL finite values including zero
donor_completion.donor_pool: finite values in original eligible training rows only, sorted by canonical company_code/fiscal_year; row multiplicity retained
donor_completion.draw: one observed value with replacement per missing cell
donor_completion.cell_rng: PCG64 seeded from first 16 SHA256 bytes of canonical JSON [V27-B-v2, imputation_seed, feature_name, company_code, fiscal_year]; unbiased rejection sampling over uint64
donor_completion.nonfinancial_processing: V26 learner handling unchanged; no imputation of audit/pledge/controller/RPT/feat columns
donor_completion.upstream_finite_missingness_encodings: not removed by B; log derived-zero and zind limitations; B0 deletes entire FIN87 block
donor_completion.all_nonfinite_training_feature: STOP, no constant fallback, no automatic feature removal
donor_completion.scaler: fit separately within each completed world using eligible training rows only; RF remains unscaled
donor_completion.selection_across_worlds: forbidden; retain all three; not three independently observed test cohorts
donor_completion.uncertainty: per-world company/seed intervals plus conditional equal-weight average over worlds; report world range; no Rubin rules or claimed historical-imputation uncertainty

financial_block_deletion.drop_columns: FIN87, including all their lagged/derived/zind columns in that whitelist
financial_block_deletion.family_labels: distinct ablation modality names; never mislabeled 104/129-dimensional M5/M11
financial_block_deletion.input_and_labels: same eligible company-years and original supervision as family B; no missingness indicators
financial_block_deletion.interpretation: removes direct financial-block inputs; changes available economic information and capacity; NOT an unbiased estimate of the leakage contribution
financial_block_deletion.remaining_proxy_warning: FIN87 deletion does not erase financial quantities or source-version proxies embedded in retained blocks; audit_fee_to_assets is retained and must not be described as financial-information-free.

MLP.checkpoint: earliest checkpoint attaining accepted best validation AUC; restore

GNN.updates_per_epoch: one per nonempty supervised training-year graph; never drop negative-only graphs
GNN.reverse_edges: append every reversed record once with same relation label and multiplicity
GNN.supporting_nodes: zero inputs as in V26; no extra label propagation

RandomForest_unweighted.remaining_parameters: materialize pinned-environment get_params before fitting; do not upgrade library

training_contract.threshold: max validation F1 over ascending score thresholds; first maximum (lowest threshold) via frozen f1_val_threshold; comparisons use >=
training_contract.validation_for_A: purged validation only for checkpoint, patience, F1; old thresholds or checkpoints prohibited
training_contract.validation_for_B_B0_C: original validation; not a claim of simultaneous case and financial correction
training_contract.test_access: scores and metrics only after all 105 model fits/checkpoints/validation thresholds and artifact hashes are locked
training_contract.mixed_failure_policy: preserve failures, retry only same configuration after documented technical fix and parity audit; no successful-world/seed selection

evaluation.budget: ceil(0.05 * population_N); full=422, D=422, O=422; bootstrap uses its resampled N
evaluation.r_at_10fpr: frozen V26 ROC convention including its drop_intermediate treatment, FPR tolerance 1e-12; not a validation-fixed operating point
evaluation.auc_identity: AUC_full = (13*AUC_O + 7*AUC_D)/20 per fit, only with identical negative set and unchanged 13/7 memberships
evaluation.undefined_single_class: NA with counts and reason; never 0.5 by default
evaluation.LOPO: for each of seven D-positive firm-years remove that positive from fixed-score evaluation, keep D negatives, reapply metrics; no training; descriptive only
evaluation.LOGO: add analogous positive-only leave-one-known-document/company-connected-group-out influence analysis; keep negatives, do not call a confidence interval

contrasts.A_against_V26: same-model purged-minus-original for all four models; also difference-of-the-above-contrasts; label interventions include weights, scaling and validation selection
contrasts.B: M11-M5 within each learner/world; donor-minus-existing-asof-zero-fill within learner/modality; change in feature increment
contrasts.B0: M11_no_FIN87-M5_no_FIN87 within each learner; compare increments descriptively with B and existing asof
contrasts.C: all metrics and no-model three individual-flag scores; original V26 four-flag diagnostics stay separate
contrasts.weighted_RF: existing V26 weighting sensitivity only; not a substitute for an unrun purged-weighted comparison

resampling.primary_unit: test company; all eligible years travel together
resampling.secondary_unit: connected components of company/document incidence within full test; all company rows included, exact document links only; not legal-case certification
resampling.matched_seed_draw: five labels with replacement; same draw for every compared condition
resampling.paired_cluster_draw: same cluster multiplicity weights across all compared models and all fixed donor worlds
resampling.single_class_draw: reject/redraw with log; at most 1000 attempts per replicate, else interval NA without replacing test population
resampling.interval: linear percentile 2.5/97.5, marginal exploratory; no p-values and no equivalence assertion
resampling.world_aggregation: average per-fit metrics over five model seeds and three fixed completions; NEVER metrics of ensemble-mean scores
resampling.D_S_J: descriptive per-fit estimates and influence ranges, no inferential ranking claim

multi_window.reason: additional historical partitions do not automatically restore label availability or financial vintages; test-dependent purge is not prospective prediction
multi_window.scope_cost: no temporal-generalization or validated-new-case conclusion is authorized by this single-window program
future_study_requirements: training/validation label availability at each decision date
uniform followup or explicit common-cutoff estimand
locked window list before any new-window score inspection

preflight_gates: Confirm no V27 empirical outputs have already been inspected; remote state remains unverified in this audit.
Verify all pinned raw-input hashes, StageA/StageE/StageF lineage, approved asof matrix, and exact V26 private baseline-prediction identities.
Materialize all-key positive incidence, three source flags, D/O/S/J masks; bind exact private file hashes without exporting identifying content.
Reconcile original label counts; validation identifiable/overlap=39/21; test identifiable/overlap=20/13; original D positives=7.
Inspect ambiguous document-key collisions and multi-event rows without model scores; unresolved identity ambiguity stops execution, not silent key alteration.
Construct retained masks once for every model; verify direct key disjointness; scaler/weight/checkpoint/threshold memberships; count both classes and known groups.
Require nonempty training and validation with both classes; no class/threshold fallback; report small group counts without asserting adequate power.
Verify source flags over every eligible training/validation/test row; no missing flag treated as zero; compare source_mask_counts.csv.
Verify FIN87 exact whitelist; all nonfinancial values identical to baseline; count upstream finite encodings; donors training-only and nonempty.
Prepare three complete donor matrices before any fit; prove common M5/M11 financial cells, model sharing, feature/row-order invariance and preserved finite entries.
Snapshot all input, feature-list, mask, donor, scaler, software and runner identities into immutable RUN_BINDINGS_v2 before first fit.
Review adapted runner: strict determinism after every seed reset, reverse messages, explicit masks, saved validation/test keys, checkpoints and preprocessors; synthetic parity tests only.
Fail closed on stale results: no reuse based only on result.json existence; exact protocol/config/input identities required.
Enforce train/validation-only Stage T and all-105 checkpoint lock before test Stage E; wrapper must not call frozen core test metrics during Stage T.
